messages:
Maya (PM Partnerships): Kickoff for ShadowRun joint perf bench — DayZero sync Wed 9am PT. Goal: perf/W sweep + throughput sweep + kernel flag A/B. Need NDA/creds, S3 path, telemetry schema, and a short smoke plan. @Tom can ShadowRun confirm node availability and data sharing method?
Tom (ShadowRun HW): Yep, we can provide 1 NIMBLE32 node. Will share SSH + SFTP creds after NDA signed. Reserved Wed 9-12 PT. We can stream thermal sensor logs (/sys/class/thermal) — ok to collect?
Asha (Eng-Perf): Fine to collect thermal logs. Preference: use our bench image ghcr.io/redwood/bench:dayzero-latest so environment's consistent. Kernel note: please enable the KV_CACHE improvement module (CONFIG_IMPROVED_K_CACHE=y) for the test. Sample run (short):
```
# run throughput sweep, 8 threads, seq_len=2048
bench run --image ghcr.io/redwood/bench:dayzero-latest --workload=llama-7b --concurrency=8 --seq-len=2048 --out s3://redwood-shadowrun/bench/$RUN_ID/
```
Luis (Partner Eng): Can we lock metric names so analysis is automated? Propose: tokens_per_sec, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, avg_watts, joules_per_token, kv_cache_hit_pct. Also standardize s3 path: s3://redwood-shadowrun/bench/<run_ts>/<run_id>/ with run_meta.json.
Maya (PM Partnerships): Agreed on metrics. Important: NO customer payloads in bench runs, anonymize inputs. We will add NDA/POC clause about telemetry. Benchbot will tag runs with run_id and bench-tag "shadowrun-dayzero".
bench-bot: Auto: scheduled smoke test Wed 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT) — command queued: bench run --profile=dayzero --tag=shadowrun-dayzero --out=s3://redwood-shadowrun/bench/20260325_160000/
Kevin (Eng-SRE): Networking checklist: allowlist ShadowRun egress IP 52.12.34.56 -> bench infra 10.0.12.0/22 on ports 22,443,9000. We'll need SSH pubkey fingerprint to pin. Also we'll create temporary bucket policy and presigned upload keys.
Tom (ShadowRun HW): SSH fingerprint: SHA256:AbC123xYz987+... Credentials will be uploaded to partner-vault and I'll DM the SRE team. We can stream telemetry via sftp or give a VPN tunnel if you prefer.
Asha (Eng-Perf): Ops asks: collect hw counters via perf (cycles, instructions), ipmi/power for watts, and nvml for GPU stats. Short commands:
```
# nvml sampling
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 1 > power.csv &
# perf counters (sample)
perf stat -e cycles,instructions -o perf.txt -- bench run ...
```
Also capture dmesg and kernel config: make sure CONFIG_PREEMPT and CONFIG_HZ_250 noted.
Luis (Partner Eng): We'll also capture baseline with stock kernel and then with kernel-flag-A enabled for comparison. Can you define the exact flag toggles so we can script the reboots?
Asha (Eng-Perf): Kernel flags to toggle: improved_kv_cache=1 vs 0 and l2_prefetch=1 vs 0. We'll provide a small script to flip and reboot: `scripts/toggle_kernel_flags.sh`. Keep runs deterministic: use fixed seed in bench config.
Maya (PM Partnerships): I'll assemble a 1-page runbook and calendar invite; will include run window, owner per step, and success criteria (stable p50 within 10% and >X tokens/s at <Y W). :rocket: Any blocking items?
Tom (ShadowRun HW): NDA is in legal review today, ETA EOD. We'll prepare VM image snapshot and thermal sensor export.
Kevin (Eng-SRE): I'll create the temporary bucket and IAM role. Please DM me the partner-allowed IPs and SSH fingerprint.
Maya (PM Partnerships): Awesome — next actions: 1) Tom: NDA + creds, 2) Asha: bench image + toggle script, 3) Kevin: infra allowlist + bucket, 4) Luis: metric schema JSON. I'll post final runbook here by EOD.
Tom (ShadowRun HW): Sounds good. See you Wed. :+1:
